capabilities: Mark canvas cards with slide numbers in order
Store the slide sequence in a generated card on the canvas
Navigate to the next or previous slide
disambiguation: Despite the presentation theme, it only sequences cards on an existing canvas; it does not create slides from note content.
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugin market; installation is via BRAT or manual download.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to define a slide order among cards and present them sequentially.
summary: Canvas helper that marks cards in a chosen order and steps through them as a slideshow with next/previous slide commands.
